#get only Croco5_log files \(these files appear at top of list on github\)
tmp <- subset\(file_names, substring\(file_names, 1, 10\) == "Croco5_log"\)
N <- as.numeric\(length\(tmp\)\)/# Use cached data to avoid network access in this reproduction environment
load("../data/DemoData5")
# number of participant logs in the cached data
